jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Founded in Sweden in 1936, Hubexo specializes in project information, eTendering, product information, market intelligence, and specification. With operations in more than 20 countries and a workforce of 2,500 employees, Hubexo helps its customers sell more efficiently, build sustainably, and lead the future of construction innovation. Do the right thing - Stand firm in your values and let integrity guide your actions at every turn. You’ll ensure we get the best value from our suppliers — not just in cost, but in performance, reliability, and innovation. If you’re a seasoned negotiator who knows how to balance business, technology, and supplier relationships, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Drive IT sourcing strategies and contract negotiations across hardware, software, cloud, and services. Manage vendor relationships, performance, and governance to ensure delivery excellence. Partner with IT, Finance, and Legal to align vendor spend with business goals. Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost optimization and innovation. Support procurement transformation and process improvement initiatives. Track and report procurement metrics to improve visibility and decision-making.
